g.text: APPSI-139 test half: heads shifted toward the tuning half's category mix

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b42

g.text: 6,058 sentences | sample appsi139-test-half | accepted labels appsi139-astra | 10 categories | 6 runs

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Bars show individual runs; no confidence intervals or averaging of repetitions.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: GPU allocation: PyTorch peak allocated bytes on CUDA device 0, including resident weights and inference intermediates; excludes unused cached memory, other allocations, and CPU RAM.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Inference time: classifier forward pass, embedding forward pass (fitted head not timed); excludes model loading and input preparation.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Non-generative strategies write their top-scoring category as the answer, so they are always valid; generative validity checks the JSON the model wrote.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Accuracy accepts any category marked in appsi139-astra; invalid outputs stay incorrect. Macro accuracy weights each category equally, grouping sentences by their original labels.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526379

g.text: Every run is scored, costs included, on the sentences of appsi139-test-half alone, including runs made on a larger sample.
